name: Shift note reader
summary: Reads the shift notes that support workers and carers write after a visit, checks each one for the points it must cover, and leaves a review comment for the supervisor on any note that misses one. Crons read and draft only; nothing reaches a worker or a client.

covered_by.roster-shift: gap (roster is read by the platform, not by this workflow)
covered_by.shift-start: gap (the platform app runs the start of shift)
covered_by.in-shift-observations: gap (worker logs these in the app)
covered_by.write-shift-note: skill (worker writes the note in the app)
covered_by.correct-note: gap (sending a note back to one worker is not mapped)
covered_by.timesheet-billing: gap (the platform runs timesheets and billing)
covered_by.compliance-check: check (keyword checks for the points in settings)

crons.name: collect
crons.summary: Read yesterday's and today's timesheets and keep each new shift note that has text.

crons.name: check
crons.summary: Check each new note for the points in settings. Leave a review comment on the timesheet when a note misses one.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations reach nobody outside the business: timesheet reads and an internal review comment on a timesheet that the supervisor sees. Nothing is sent to a worker, client, GP or plan manager, and no live operation is mapped for this workflow yet.

deputy.covers: timesheet read, note text, supervisor review comment

gaps: ShiftCare, the platform most calls name (23 help pages, no API operations found), has no adapter in the kit. A ShiftCare account is needed to confirm its API and where notes are stored.

Sending a note back to the worker (correct-note) needs a memo addressed to one worker. The kit maps Deputy memo creation, but the recipient step is not confirmed against the vendor spec, so no live operation is queued.
The note text is read from the timesheet field EmployeeComment. Confirm on a live Deputy account that shift notes are stored there.
Only two crons. No cron queues an approval because no live operation is safe yet.
Incident recording, medication logs, in-shift observations, shift start, handover and client or family updates are not in the mined pages or not mapped. Workers and coordinators keep them.
The compliance check is keyword matching for the points in settings. It is not a regulator or funder check, and a person still reads every note.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
The timesheet search reads the first page of results only. Paging is not built, so a busy day can miss notes until it is added.
The Deputy adapter is docs-only until a sandbox account proves it.
